instruction: Set the editor font size to 18 in VS Code.

metadata.capability_extraction: Can open VS Code extensions sidebar, search marketplace, install extensions, navigate VS Code UI, interact with settings
metadata.task_rationale: Tests VS Code settings modification capability using the same environment setup - a related but different operation type
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing editor font size to 18. Evaluator reads settings.json via vscode_config getter and checks editor.fontSize equals 18.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vscode_config) correctly opens VS Code command palette, executes 'Preferences: Open Settings (JSON)', and fetches the settings.json file from the correct path

Metric (check_json_settings) correctly receives the rules dict via get_rule, accesses expected['expected'] to get {'editor.fontSize': 18}, and iterates key-value pairs checking exact match in actual settings JSON
Complete coverage: instruction requires setting editor font size to 18, evaluator checks exactly editor.fontSize == 18
Data flow is correct: getter returns file path -> metric opens and parses JSON -> compares against expected values
